review_evidence: README states that the project formalizes Kummer’s criterion, replacing the class-number condition for regular primes by a finite Bernoulli-number criterion, and points to KummerCriterion/Main.lean as the main theorem.

The 129 formal files develop Bernoulli computations with correctness proofs, cyclotomic units, Gauss sums, class-number formulae, Kummer congruences, irregular primes, and p-adic/cyclotomic infrastructure.

The declaration inventory found roughly 1,988 definitions and proposition declarations, including bernoulliComputeFrac_toRat_eq_bernoulli, regular-prime computations below 100, and fermatLastTheoremFor_le100_of_ne_irregular.
summary: Retain KummerCriterion: it is a substantial number-theory formalization centered on Kummer’s criterion for regular primes.

review_evidence: Size and declaration-count survey of all 31 files: minimum 2900 bytes (LehmerVandiver/PlusCoprime/CharacterIdentification.lean, 2 declarations), maximum 44335 bytes (HMinus/LValueReduction/Teichmuller.lean, 70 declarations); every file has at least 2 declarations.
grep -c sorry over all 31 files: 0 in every file.

Read KummerCriterion/LehmerVandiver/PlusCoprime/CharacterIdentification.lean completely: two proved theorems on the cyclotomic-unit pair-up identity zeta^c * cyclotomicUnit (p - c) = -cyclotomicUnit c, citing Washington Lemma 8.2/8.4.

Read first 60 lines of KummerCriterion/HMinus/HMinusCriterion.lean: lemma exists_odd_index_iff_exists_k and theorem p_dvd_hMinus_iff_p_dvd_some_bernoulli (p divides h^- iff p divides a Bernoulli numerator).
Read first 40 lines of KummerCriterion/GaussSum/Basic.lean: module doc listing Gauss sum results for Dirichlet characters mod p, followed by declarations.

Listed declaration heads in KummerCriterion/CyclotomicUnits/KummerLogFormalEvaluator/Homogeneous.lean and KummerCriterion/HMinus/LValueReduction/Teichmuller.lean: theorems on Dwork coefficients, hMinus_formula, and zeta-function residue limits.
summary: Surveyed all 31 listed Lean files under KummerCriterion/ (subdirectories BernoulliFast, CyclotomicUnits, GaussSum, HMinus, IrregularPrimes, LValueAtOne, LehmerVandiver, Reflection, TotallyRealSubfield, ZetaFactorisation) by byte size, a grep count of theorem/lemma/def/abbrev/structure/instance/class/inductive lines, and a grep count of sorry. Every file is in the main source tree, is 2900 to 44335 bytes, and holds 2 to 70 declarations with 0 sorry occurrences. Read the smallest file completely and sampled others; all are formal number-theory content (cyclotomic units, Dwork/Artin-Hasse, relative class number formula, L-values, Gauss sums) for Kummer's criterion. No file lacks formal declarations, so all are retained.
